test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the highlighted word.

Two original manuscripts of this text are still **extant.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'extinct'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the **given word** and the **marked option:**

 
 
• **Extant:** (especially of a document) still in existence; surviving.

 
 
• ***Example:*** *Two fourteenth-century manuscripts of this text are still** extant. ***
 
 
 
• **Extinct:** (of a species, family, or another group of animals or plants) having no living members; no longer in existence.
 
 
• ***Example: ****It is 250 years since the wolf became **extinct **in Britain*.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, from above, we can say that the correct answer is **option 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Negotiate: **obtain or bring about by discussion.
 
• **Drool: **make an excessive and obvious show of pleasure or desire.
 
• **Persist: **continue firmly or obstinately in an opinion or a course of action in spite of difficulty, opposition, or failure.
